title: Daily Devotional #59
paragraphs: Today, as I read Luke 15, I was struck by the message of your unwavering love and the joy that comes from repentance. In this chapter, Jesus tells three parables to illustrate the immense value you place on each and every one of us.

The first parable is about the lost sheep. Even if just one sheep goes astray, the good shepherd will leave the other 99 to search for it. The second parable is about a lost coin. The woman who lost the coin searched diligently until she found it. And the third parable is the story of the prodigal son, who squandered his inheritance but was welcomed back with open arms by his father when he returned.

These stories remind me that no matter how lost I feel, you are always searching for me, eager to bring me back into your loving embrace. Even when I stray from your path, you never give up on me. Your love is unconditional, and it never fails.

But these parables also remind me that I have a responsibility to seek you out. I need to recognize my own waywardness and turn back to you. When I do, the joy and celebration in heaven is beyond measure. Just as the father in the prodigal son parable welcomed his son back with open arms, you welcome me back into your loving arms.
Lord, help me to always remember the message of Luke 15. Help me to trust in your love and mercy, and to seek you out when I stray from your path. Thank you for your unwavering love and grace.
